worldcombat.skill.shedtail.summary: Shed half your HP to leave a tail behind that keeps enemies hooked, then pull out along a chosen direction; with a reserve the move swaps straight to it. Until it is broken or fades, the tail draws nearby enemies back onto itself.
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.description.0: Pay %1$s of your max HP to leave a tail behind with %2$s of your max HP in health; enemies can attack it, and it is torn apart when that health runs out.
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.description.1: You withdraw %1$s blocks along the chosen direction; every 20 ticks the tail re-targets enemies within %2$s blocks onto itself, and it lasts at most %3$s before being torn apart or expiring.
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.timing: %1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.use.0: Slip away before being overwhelmed and leave pursuers a tail
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.use.1: Block a choke point with the tail
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.preference.ai: The fraction that must remain after paying half your HP; higher means it may simply refuse to shed.
The tail always lands in place; this changes where you go: away from the threat to open distance, or back toward your owner.
When on, the user may shed and pull out even while holding a station; when off it only casts where it stands conveniently.
world_combat.move.shedtail.text.shed: Shed Tail · a tail is left behind
world_combat.move.shedtail.text.break: The shed tail was torn apart
worldcombat.skill.shedtail.description.a: If your party has a legal reserve, it is sent out at your landing point; the tail stays behind and does not vanish when you switch out or leave. You cannot shed again while the tail lasts.
